acceptance_criteria.description: Record physical identity and capture environment for ELECOM DEFT M-DT2DRBK V02 on 2.4 GHz receiver.
Capture USB enumeration data and complete HID descriptors for every HID interface.
Capture timestamped raw reports for required controls, axes, wheels/pan and simultaneous inputs.
Record observed and descriptor-derived report lengths and complete report inventory.
Evaluate captured evidence against current KQM constraints without an overall compatibility claim.
Validate JSON/NDJSON, hashes, lengths and separation of observed bytes from interpretation.
Reach a hardware-backed conclusion sufficient for the next engineering decision.
Maintain valid bounded-loop state and append-only iteration evidence.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Iterations 1 and 2 are appended in docs/feather-quantizer/loop/runs/003-deft-hid-capture/iterations.md and this state is validated by verify-loop-state.py.

last_failure_signature: Required DEFT M-DT2DRBK V02 2.4 GHz receiver capture is absent.
